title: Pentaryn NPC Ties
description: Who knows who. Records directed relationships between actors — a stance, a one-word label, a strength and a page of notes — edits them on a Ties tab on the actor sheet, and paints them on the canvas: hover a token, press the Ties key, and everyone that person knows who is in sight is labelled with what they are to them. Two keys: one word each, or draggable cards with token art. Distant ties get a thin line instead of a floating label. Players can use it on their own character — only their own connections, only what their token can actually see. Client-side only. Exposes game.pentaryn.ties.
